designationHistory.name: Muddy Creek Refuge (Refuge No. 3)
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established Refuge No. 3, the Muddy Creek Refuge, as a game sanctuary and refuge in the Ouachita National Forest, Arkansas.

sources.name: Proclamation 2119, Ouachita National Game Refuges, Mar. 8, 1935, 49 Stat. 3439 (govinfo)

designationHistory.name: Ouachita National Wildlife Preserve
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt enlarged the Muddy Creek Refuge and renamed it the Ouachita National Wildlife Preserve.
